shortDescription: Managing masking views on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System.

options.name: host_name
options.description: The name of the existing host. This parameter is to create an exclusive or host export.

options.name: hostgroup_name
options.description: The name of the existing host group. This parameter is used to create cluster export.

options.name: mv_name
options.description: The name of the masking view. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: new_mv_name
options.description: The new name for the renaming function. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: portgroup_name
options.description: The name of the existing port group.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: sg_name
options.description: The name of the existing storage group.

options.name: starting_lun_address
options.description: Option to manually set the starting LUN address for the volumes in the masking view. If not specified, the Host LUN Address will be automatically set to the next available. Affect only MV creation, it is not idempotent

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the masking view should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
